## Aurora Connection Retries

Aurora permits **two (2) connection retries** before displaying a connection error.

### Details

| Detail | Information |
|---|---|
| **Retry limit** | 2 retries |
| **Behavior after limit is exceeded** | Aurora displays a connection error |
| **Context** | Recent project decision regarding retry configuration |

The available information from the reviewed project knowledge indicates that Aurora's connection handling was configured with a retry limit of two attempts. This means that if an initial connection attempt fails, the system will automatically make up to two additional retry attempts. Only after these two retries are exhausted does Aurora surface a connection error to the user.

This **2-retry** policy appears to be an intentional design decision—rather than either giving up immediately on the first failure or retrying indefinitely—which is typically implemented to balance resilience (tolerating transient blips) against latency and avoiding infinite loops on genuinely unreachable services.

### Summary

- Aurora retries a failed connection **up to two times**.
- The **third failure** (after the two retries) results in a displayed connection error.
